purpose: Champion-B search. Screen TabPFN-2.6 as a structurally distinct route member under the MATCHED champion-route protocol (only model_path differs) and decide by a frozen rule whether to promote it to a full 5-fold OOF run. This is catalogue row 13 continued (its GPU arm was deferred behind the champion reproduction).

checkpoint.license: TABPFN-2.6 Non-Commercial License v1.0; Data Science Competitions explicitly included (eligible); text at artifacts/tabpfn26/LICENSE, provenance at research/raw/tabpfn26_provenance.json

matched_protocol.features: champion route view, 22 columns, identical construction (scripts/phase16_tabpfn.prepare via run_phase17_tabpfn)
matched_protocol.fit_rows: folds != k (fold k=0 screen); immutable primary registry
matched_protocol.params: n_estimators=1, fit_mode=fit_with_cache, kv_cache_precision=int8, keep_cache_on_device=True, inference_precision=autocast(bf16), random_state=1201, ignore_pretraining_limits=True, categorical_features_indices from the route view -- taken verbatim from scripts/run_sol_tabpfn.py:112-115; ONLY model_path differs from the champion route
matched_protocol.no_gradient_fitting: pretrained inference only; no early stopping; no outer labels in any fit or configuration

step_0_feasibility_probe.when: before the full screen, if the full-context fit has not been shown feasible for this checkpoint
step_0_feasibility_probe.what: fit on a stratified 50k-row context and predict 4096 eval rows at batch 2048; record wall time, peak VRAM, and the per-batch rate
step_0_feasibility_probe.claim: NONE -- resource engineering only; no scientific content; never reported as a model result

measured.standalone_fold0_auc: primary fold-0 AUC of the v2.6 member
measured.blend_with_v7: equal-logit blend of (v2.6 member, true v7 champion) on fold-0; port_delta_v7 = AUC(blend) - AUC(v7 fold-0 = 0.9618278142504795)
measured.blend_with_route_ref: frozen OBJ-style diagnostic: port_delta vs sol_route_aux10_primary_final fold-0 (0.9617271804553859)
measured.correlations: Spearman + logit Pearson vs v7 and vs route_ref
measured.paired_bootstrap: row bootstrap within fold-0, B=2000, seed 7, 95% CI of port_delta_v7 (the single-fold uncertainty that decides promotion)

frozen_decision_rule.PROMOTE_to_5fold_OOF: paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of port_delta_v7 > 0 AND spearman(v2.6, v7) < 0.995 AND standalone >= 0.960457 (v6 route fold-0 0.961457 minus 1e-3; guards against a catastrophically weaker checkpoint)
frozen_decision_rule.CLOSE: paired-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound of port_delta_v7 <= 0
frozen_decision_rule.AMBIGUOUS: CI straddles 0 without satisfying PROMOTE -- recorded, NOT promoted (budget discipline); the frozen gate does not move
frozen_decision_rule.note: one fold cannot certify +3e-4; it can only rule out or flag. Promotion buys the 5-fold OOF that decides PATH A/B.

resource_guard_preregistered.if_full_context_fit_or_predict_OOMs: amend ONCE (recorded before the amended run) to context=stratified 100000 rows from FIT, predict batch=1024, everything else identical; the amendment must be committed before the rerun and the context bound is disclosed in every downstream claim
resource_guard_preregistered.if_the_amendment_also_OOMs: RESOURCE_BLOCKED with the measured evidence; no result, no promotion
resource_guard_preregistered.chunk_invariance_note: in fit_with_cache mode the KV cache is built from train rows only and eval rows are queries, so query-batch size does not change per-row predictions
resource_guard_preregistered.no_disk_offload: explicitly forbidden (hardware history: nvlddmkm Event 153 and a near-full C: drive)

non_goals: No hyperparameter changes to help the checkpoint.
No public-LB consultation at any point.
The champion v7 is never modified; the candidate gets its own artifact paths and store id.
